experiment: M1: lend the shared Metal allocation to read mappings instead of copying it into a malloc'd host shadow (m1/candidate.patch). One mechanism; control is main d57ab2877.

host.label: apple-host
host.machine: Apple M3 (8 CPU cores, 10 GPU cores), 24 GiB unified memory
host.power: internal battery, 100% at freeze, low-power mode off; power source must stay unchanged per window
host.sharedUse: desktop session with an external 2560x1440 120 Hz display, browser and other app renderers stay running (idle GPU utilization 13-14% at freeze); the Reploid contributors are disabled

sourceCommit: d57ab2877 (library); harness and cohort tool are d57ab2877 plus the uncommitted Metal port (hashes below)
surface: dropin (public webgpu.h ABI); one harness source linked per provider, compiled with -DDOE_PHASE_BACKEND_METAL
workloadOrigin: unchanged amd-host C1 workloads; inputs manifest byte-identical to the amd-host and intel-host manifests (afe4e1d3...); independent CPU oracle on every iteration outside the timed interval

providers.dawn: source-built Dawn d04f88359391a12375c1a3e948a0b2dcb4c97a18 (the amd-host and intel-host revision), CMake Release, DAWN_BUILD_MONOLITHIC_LIBRARY=SHARED, Metal only, tests/samples/GLFW off, Tint SPIR-V/GLSL/HLSL writers off, Apple clang
providers.dawn-aa: byte-identical copy of the dawn harness binary (A/A control)

sampling.orders: all 24 permutations of the 4 providers, cycled

timing: CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW (Darwin CLOCK_MONOTONIC is quantized to 1 us); host clock, not GPU timestamps
phases: identical to amd-host contract-c1.json; complete = compile + pipeline + resources + sum of every iteration's operation + teardown
statistics: per-pair ratio provider/dawn; median ratio, bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029), provider-faster pair count

validity: every process status ok with all 32 iterations oracle-checked
every provider reports a Metal adapter that is not a CPU adapter
A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median ratio within [0.95,1.05] and its CI95 contains 1, per workload
window gate (tools/mac_window.py) valid: power source and low-power mode unchanged, no thermal warning, idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity
acceptance.mechanismRule: m1/main: warm.map and warm.operation CI95 upper < 1.0 on every workload, and every noRegress metric CI95 lower <= 1.05 on every workload. Correctness (recorded before freezing): Metal physical clients match main per client, backends/metal check, native-check and native-graphics-check pass.
acceptance.invalidWindows: an invalid window is retained, never used for the verdict, and rerun fresh once under the unchanged contract
acceptance.claimBoundary: A pass accepts the mechanism for the Metal C runtime on apple-host only; it does not by itself make a scoped win against Dawn and says nothing about Vulkan or D3D12.

evaluatorAmendment: tools/evaluate.py gained --aa (A/A read against aaControl) before any timed window of this contract; the rules are unchanged.
gateAmendment: Before any timed window of this contract: the 5% foreign-CPU limit was copied from the Linux hosts without measuring this desktop. Measured idle desktop baseline about 13% of capacity (WindowServer ~0.42 core, app renderers ~0.3-0.5 core); Spotlight bursts 54-63%. Limit set to 20%. tools/wait_quiet.sh schedules windows into quiet slots and is not a validity rule.
